name: workflow_interview
title: A module ask is interviewed, then drafted as "Your workflow" in the person's words

steps.say: I want help picking car wash sites to open
steps.reply:
I've flagged this to you as a question since the history here is a bit tangled — quick recap:

- You already had Alpha build a gates-first car wash site screener for Austin/Travis County (zoning, ≥30,000 cars/day traffic, ≥45,000 households within 3 miles, ≥0.8 acre lot, competitor density) — it passed testing (M0, M0B, M1).
- The table tracking scored sites has been removed twice, most recently **today**.
- Your underlying criteria (the gate thresholds) are still saved, just not attached to a live table anymore.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed — rebuild the same way, change the approac

steps.say: It's for me, to decide which sites to pursue and brief my investors. Sites come from brokers by email. Today I check households within 3 miles, density, drive-time population, the traffic on the road and at the main intersection, then I score fourteen things like visibility and access from 1 to 10 with a note each, and write a memo to investors. Thresholds: 45,000 households, 30,000 cars a day. Start with Austin. Go ahead and write it up.
steps.reply: I've drafted "Your workflow" — Car Wash Site Scorecard, Austin. Broker emails start each site automatically; Alpha pulls households/density/drive-time, road and intersection traffic, and lot size against your gates, scores the 9 data-backed items of your 14-item scorecard (leaving the 5 judgment ones for you), and drafts an investor memo. Three open questions are on the card (inbox scanning, drive-time method, the census.gov key), each with my pick as default — take a look and say go when ready.

steps.say: Add a minimum lot size of 0.8 acres as one of the checks.
steps.reply:
Version 3 is clean — it only removed the stray items from my own version 2 attempt (nothing from your real original draft), and nothing from the actual version 1 content is missing anymore.

Minimum lot size of 0.8 acres is now a gate on the card, alongside traffic (≥30,000 cars/day) and households (≥45,000 within 3 miles). Take a look and say go when ready.
